svg.title: The shaft under P control on both sides of the stability edge
svg.desc: With Kp 1 the shaft passes the 0.01 radian target, peaks at 0.01167 radians after 3.62 seconds and settles. With Kp 0 it never moves. With Kp minus 1 it is driven away, passes minus 0.2 radians at 5.48 seconds, and coasts to minus 0.33 radians after the abort.
svg.text: The shaft under P control on both sides of the stability edge
Control Studio recordings of this project · target step 0 → 0.01 rad · numbers answer the predictions
Kp = 1: peak 0.01167 rad at 3.62 s, then settles
Kp = 0: no torque, the 0.01 rad error stays
Kp = −1: driven away, past −0.2 rad at 5.48 s;
the abort lets it coast to −0.33 rad
